description.value: Long Beach Golf Course is a 9-hole championship course minutes from the world-famous Long Beach in Pacific Rim National Park, operating a Tacofino food outlet on site alongside a campground, driving range, and pro shop. The Tacofino serves tacos, burritos, and snacks in a casual West Coast counter-service style that fits the area's surf-and-outdoors culture. Situated on the Pacific Rim Highway between Ucluelet and Tofino, it sits squarely on one of BC's most-travelled cycle-touring corridors.
